[[Heart of the Forest]] Tier 4 |music = "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Torrhus Canyon|Torrhus Canyon]]" |location = [[Torrhus Canyon]] |location_guide=At or above Y=135 |mobs = * Beeheemoth * Blue Jay * Cheeky Tiki * Drybark * Firefox * Grizzly Bear * Groundhog * Mountain Goat * Puck * Shrieky Tiki * Sneaky Tiki }} The '''Torrhus Heights''' is a [[Location]] found on the {{zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. It represents the higher up portions of the island. {{ZoneText|&eHunt &fcritters that live up here.}} == Features == The '''Torrhus Heights''' represents the top portion of the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. Players can harvest [[Helix Tree]]s for {{Item|Helix Log}}s and go [[Hunting]] for unique [[Critters]]. Throughout the area, players can find {{MobSprite|Sneaky Tiki}} totems that, when rotated, will spawn a {{MobSprite|Cheeky Tiki}}, {{MobSprite|Shrieky Tiki}}, or {{MobSprite|Sneaky Tiki}}. There are also {{MobSprite|Mountain Goat}}s, {{MobSprite|Groundhog}}s, and {{MobSprite|Firefox}}es, which spawn naturally. On higher up trees, players can find {{MobSprite|Blue Jay}}s, which can be caught using a [[Lasso]] after standing still. Similarly, a {{MobSprite|Beeheemoth}} can occasionally spawn in the area. == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Fairy Souls == {{Fairy Souls}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/July 10|Added '''Torrhus Heights'''.}} |beta = {{History|0.27|Added '''Torrhus Heights'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Locations}}
